parameters.name: ProgramConfig
parameters.description: The playlist configuration. For more information, see **ProgramConfig**.

parameters.name: ProgramId
parameters.description: The playlist ID. If you add playlist items by calling the [AddPlaylistItems](~~2848078~~) operation, use the ProgramId value returned by the call.

parameters.name: ProgramItems
parameters.description: The list of playlist items. This is a JSON string. For more information, see **InputProgramItem**.
